items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Diosa used to go out there everyday and then she married with Pupi Campo and we, we got together. She helped me tremendously.

ctx.x: he gave it two-weeks notice to the band that he has, So I had the contract in my pocket and I went to Lopez and Lopez said: "no because - come tomorrow to sign the papers because" so and so and so, you know. I feel like so kind of leary about it - that he was hesitant to sign - so I went to La Conga, to Jack Harris, to visit him. He said: "Well, what you have in mind"? I said: "well, we like to work here." So "No, I have Noro Morales. But don't worry. One day, I'll get you. So Noro Morales was a soft-touch…

Before we play La Conga, we played the Beachcomber, where the Hawaii Kai is, and we were the talk of the town. Diosa used to go out there everyday and then she married with Pupi Campo and we, we got together. She helped me tremendously.
Okay, let's not get ahead or ourselves. There came a time when you signed a contract with Decca. They heard you, right? They heard you at the Park [Plaza]
